description.content:
The Gamesight Measurement API ingests a stream of in-game event data with device-level identifiers to power marketing attribution and measurement for PC, console, and web games. Send single events to /events or batches to /events/batch, and manage per-game do-not-track (GDPR/CCPA opt-out) state.

Contact Support:
 Name: Gamesight Support
 Email: support@gamesight.io
